name: Mac Trackpad
author: 2strange
description: Mac-like settings for the built-in trackpad, in the bar: natural scrolling, tracking and scroll speed, tap to click, two-finger right click, ignore while typing, applied live through Hyprland. No daemon: the menu writes ~/.config/hypr/trackpad.lua and adds one marked loader block to input.lua. Plus its own three-finger workspace swipe: it works from workspace 1, can keep empty workspaces 1-5, and at the last workspace stops or opens a new one (the workspace follows your fingers) or wraps around. With three fingers set, the MagicMouse plugin's two-finger swipe is this same gesture.

barWidget.description: Click for trackpad settings; every control applies live through hypr/trackpad.lua
